title: Serpenphare - Location, Weakness & Shield Strategy
description: Serpenphare is the floating optional boss on The Continent that drains your party's AP and stacks shields. Where to find it and how to beat it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
The Serpenphare is a floating boss with a pink tail and plants growing across its body, found on The Continent. You may recognise it before you can fight it - it is visible overhead in Flying Waters early on.

It has a distinctive and annoying mechanic: it absorbs your entire party's AP, which lets it act multiple times in a row.

sections.title: Where to Find Serpenphare
sections.content:
Location: The Continent, southeast of the Boat Graveyard.

It floats in the sky, so simply fly into it. Reaching the area requires Esquie's flight ability.

sections.title: How to Beat Serpenphare
sections.content:
The real problem is the shields

Serpenphare repeatedly buffs itself with up to 9 instances of shield, which absorb incoming damage. Against a shielded target, most of your damage simply disappears.

Answers to shields

  • Lune's Tremor - removes all shields
  • Maelle's Breaking Rules - removes all shields, deals damage, and restores AP per shield removed

Either of these turns a grindy fight into a straightforward one.

Alternative: overwhelm with multi-hits

If you cannot spare a shield-stripper, multi-hit skills can chew through the shield stack: Lune's Elemental Genesis (also has a chance to inflict Lightning, which it is weak to) or Verso's Steeled Strike, which hits 13 times.

Watch the AP drain

Because it can absorb your party's AP and chain extra actions, expect turns where you are starved of resource. Keep a cheap, reliable filler option so you are never fully idle.
